script:
set -euo pipefail
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"; echo cleaned' EXIT
echo data > "$tmp/f"
cat "$tmp/f"
if [[ -z ${UNSET_VAR+x} ]]; then echo "is unset"; fi; EMPTY=; [[ -n ${EMPTY+x} ]] && echo "is set"
touch 'a b.txt' c.txt; while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do echo "[$f]"; done < <(find . -name '*.txt' -print0 | sort -z)
printf 'a\0b\0' > z; mapfile -d '' -t parts < z; echo "${#parts[@]} ${parts[1]}"
line=$'one\ttwo three'; IFS=$'\t' read -r a b <<< "$line"; echo "[$a] [$b]"
hex=ff; echo $(( 16#$hex )); printf -v padded '%05d' 42; echo $padded
line="first second third"; read -r first _ <<< "$line"; echo "$first"
f() { local -r c=1; c=2; echo "unreached $c"; }; f; echo "after f: $?"
init() { declare -gA REG=([k]=v); }; init; echo "${REG[k]}"
case 42 in [[:digit:]][[:digit:]]) echo two-digits;; esac
set -- $(echo "x y z"); echo "$2"; line="a b"; set -- $line; echo $#
f() { local IFS=; local s="$*"; echo "$s"; }; f a b c
keys=(b a c); IFS=$'\n' read -r -d '' -a sorted < <(printf '%s\n' "${keys[@]}" | sort; printf '\0'); echo "${sorted[*]}"
json_escape() { local s=${1//\\/\\\\}; s=${s//\"/\\\"}; printf '"%s"' "$s"; }; json_escape 'say "hi" \ ok'; echo
join() { local IFS="$1"; shift; echo "$*"; }; join , a b c; join '' x y
trim() { local v="$1"; v="${v#"${v%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; v="${v%"${v##*[![:space:]]}"}"; printf '%s' "$v"; }; echo "[$(trim '   hi there  ')]"
in_array() { local n=$1; shift; local e; for e in "$@"; do [[ $e == "$n" ]] && return 0; done; return 1; }; arr=(a b c); in_array b "${arr[@]}" && echo found; in_array z "${arr[@]}" || echo missing
str="a,b;c d"; IFS=',; ' read -ra toks <<< "$str"; echo "${#toks[@]}: ${toks[*]}"
v=3; case $v in 1|2) echo low;; 3|4) echo mid;; *) echo high;; esac
printf '%s\n' "${!BASH_VERSINFO[@]}" | tail -1
declare -A seen; dups=(); for w in a b a c b; do [[ -n ${seen[$w]:-} ]] && dups+=("$w"); seen[$w]=1; done; echo "${dups[@]}"
ver1=1.10.2 ver2=1.9.0; if [[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$ver1" "$ver2" | sort -V | head -1)" == "$ver2" ]]; then echo "$ver1 is newer"; fi
lower=${1:-DEFAULT}; echo "${lower,,}"
n=0; while :; do (( ++n >= 5 )) && break; done; echo $n
for f in /etc/hostname /nonexistent; do if [[ -r $f ]]; then echo "readable: $f"; else echo "skip: $f"; fi; done
out=$( { echo stdout; echo stderr >&2; } 2>/dev/null ); echo "[$out]"
{ read -r header; while read -r row; do echo "row: $row"; done; } <<< $'h\nr1\nr2'

cnt=$(printf 'a
b
c
' | wc -l); echo $(( cnt + 0 ))
arr=(); [[ ${#arr[@]} -eq 0 ]] && echo empty; arr+=(""); [[ ${#arr[@]} -eq 1 ]] && echo one-empty
s="key1=val1&key2=val2"; IFS='&' read -ra pairs <<< "$s"; for p in "${pairs[@]}"; do echo "${p%%=*} -> ${p#*=}"; done
path="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"; IFS=: read -ra dirs <<< "$path"; echo "${#dirs[@]} ${dirs[0]}"; [[ ":$path:" == *":/usr/bin:"* ]] && echo has-usr-bin
max() { local m=$1; shift; for n; do (( n > m )) && m=$n; done; echo $m; }; max 3 9 2 7
repeat() { local s; printf -v s '%*s' "$2" ''; echo "${s// /$1}"; }; repeat - 5
s="abc"; rev=""; for (( i=${#s}-1; i>=0; i-- )); do rev+=${s:i:1}; done; echo $rev
declare -A m=([x]=1 [y]=2); for k in $(echo "${!m[@]}" | tr ' ' '\n' | sort); do printf '%s=%s ' "$k" "${m[$k]}"; done; echo
x='a b'; arr=($x "$x"); echo ${#arr[@]}
mkdir zeta alpha && touch beta.txt Cfile && ls -d zeta alpha beta.txt /tmp Cfile
mkdir zeta alpha && touch beta.txt && ls -dr zeta alpha beta.txt /tmp
mkdir zeta alpha && touch beta.txt Cfile && ls zeta beta.txt alpha Cfile
